summary_en: The study tests surovatamig (also called AZD0486), a CD19 by CD3 bispecific T-cell engager, alone or with other anticancer drugs, in adults with mature B-cell malignancies such as chronic lymphocytic leukemia, small lymphocytic lymphoma, mantle-cell lymphoma, large B-cell lymphoma, and B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. Surovatamig is given as a subcutaneous injection or an intravenous infusion, and some arms add oral acalabrutinib twice daily or intravenous R-CHOP chemotherapy with step-up dosing; the overall duration and frequency are not stated. The study measures safety and efficacy, but the specific main outcome is not stated, and the study is Phase 1/2.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa surovatamig (también llamado AZD0486), un activador de linfocitos T biespecífico CD19 por CD3, solo o con otros medicamentos contra el cáncer, en adultos con neoplasias malignas maduras de células B, como leucemia linfocítica crónica, linfoma linfocítico de células pequeñas, linfoma de células del manto, linfoma de células B grandes y linfoma no Hodgkin de células B. El surovatamig se administra como inyección subcutánea o infusión intravenosa, y algunos grupos añaden acalabrutinib oral dos veces al día o quimioterapia R-CHOP intravenosa con dosis escalonadas; la duración y la frecuencia generales no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad y la eficacia, pero el resultado principal específico no se indica, y el estudio es de Fase 1/2.
who_for: Agrees to use contraception during treatment and for at least 90 days after the final dose
CLL or SLL requiring treatment by iwCLL criteria, with prior therapy lines specified by cohort
MCL or large B-cell lymphoma with prior therapy lines specified by cohort
not_for: Prior CAR T-cell therapy or autologous stem cell transplant within 12 weeks, or prior T-cell engager within 8 weeks
Prior grade above 3 cytokine release syndrome or immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome
Active uncontrolled infection or autoimmune disease needing systemic therapy, or known history of HLH
